translations.web: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
translations.bsb: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
translations.kjv: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.
